news.title: Protect Every Animal From Cruelty? Not in 2026, Oregon Democrats Say
news.summary: A possible referendum in Oregon on animal rights would end fishing, hunting, even pest control, just when Democrats are trying really hard not to be seen as “weirdos again.”
